definitionZh: :访问的CSS伪类在用户访问链接后即适用. 出于隐私的原因,可以使用此选择器修改的样式非常有限. :visited伪类仅适用于具有href属性的a和域元素.
sourceDefinition: The :visited CSS pseudo-class applies once the link has been visited by the user. For privacy reasons, the styles that can be modified using this selector are very limited. The :visited pseudo-class applies only to a and area elements that have an href attribute.
